proposals.evidence: DEDR 4410 explicitly attests Tamil/Malayalam pēr, Kota pēr, Telugu pēru, Gadaba/Parji pidir, Gondi peder/porol, Tulu pudaru and Konda/Kuvi dōru name. The selected simple name nouns fit these branches; Indo-Aryan nām forms and potentially contact-mediated Kannada pēru are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR 183 expressly distinguishes Irula/Tulu amme ‘father’ from Kannada/Malayalam amma ‘mother’ and Kannada ‘grandmother’. The survey’s family roles are preserved; this nursery-word family does not justify changing father to mother.

proposals.evidence: DEDR 5517 directly gives Kannada beṅki ‘fire’, bisi ‘heat/hot’, beccage ‘warm’, Telugu vecca and Tulu becca ‘warm’. These distinct lexicalizations of the heat family are source-attested; source-marked Toda loans are not included.
